requirements.title: Overlay shows immediately when isGameOver(board)===true: score, best, maxTile, merges, longestStreak (FR-25, UX-DR-12, EXPERIENCE.md:73)

requirements.title: Stats are lane-scoped where relevant (best = active lane's live match.best seeded from persistedBest via initialScore/isNewRecord; best never derived from global) (P3, FR14)

tests.title: [P1] AC3 lane-scoped best is NOT inside MatchStats — matchStats only owns merges/longestStreak/maxTile/currentStreak (separation pin)
[P0] AC1/AC4 App wiring: App.tsx renders GameOverOverlay when isGameOver(game.board) and passes lane-scoped stats (isNewRecord gated on sessionStartBestRef.current)
[P0] AC1/AC2 runtime: lane-scoped MatchScore + MatchStats thin-view posture (overlay receives resolved stats + isNewRecord)

requirements.title: Game over is a state, not an error — engine emits no throw; isGameOver is called on the post-move board, overlay renders from app-owned MatchScore + MatchStats (architecture error handling, move() never throws, ADR-02/06)

tests.title: [P1] AC1/AC4 applyMoveStats determinism: same prev+board+result yields deepEqual, no mutation of prev
[P1] AC4 applyMoveStats purity: no Math.random, no engine roll symbols, host-testable (no RN)
[P1] AC4 overlay is thin-view: never imports engine roll symbols, never Math.random, never layout/orientation rule logic (ui.norolls + ui.thinview + engine.purity)
[P1] AC4 insets fallback — undefined insets yields SAFE_MARGIN-only padding (defensive, App always passes insets)
[P0] AC1/AC4 App wiring: App.tsx renders GameOverOverlay when isGameOver(game.board) (committed snapshot, not moveResult.board)
[P0] AC4/T3 handleRestart deadlock defense: App.tsx resets game + match + matchStats + busyRef
[P0] AC1 doMove projects via applyMoveStats on post-move board (maxTile monotonic source)
[P1] AC1 gameOver board edge: emptyBoard is NOT gameOver, full-but-mergeable board is NOT gameOver
[P1] reducedMotion prop gates future fade — defaults appropriately and overlay carries no transform when false (Epic 9 gate for 6.2)

coverage_heuristics.notes: Pure app-domain story: no API endpoints, no auth surfaces. Negative paths covered via NOOP/rejected-move edge tests (W-005 emptyBoard / full-but-mergeable) and zero-merge streak reset. UI journey is state-overlay (isGameOver), not a route — E2E intentionally N/A (same posture as 7.1/7.2). Error handling pinned as 'game over is state, not error' via deterministic pure projection + thin-view guards (ui.norolls/ui.thinview/engine.purity still green).
